req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with an identical payload for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must be idempotent: repeating the same request with the same payload must yield the same terminal state. The service layer has a known bug where update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit, causing the route to raise HTTP 500. Tests must probe: (1) positive — two identical PUTs both return 204 and the resource state is unchanged after the second call; (2) negative — mismatched squad_number in body vs path returns 400 on every call; (3) boundary — PUT on squad_number=1 (lowest seeded value) is idempotent; (4) boundary — PUT on squad_number=26 (highest seeded value) is idempotent; (5) state-transition — three consecutive identical PUTs all return the same status code, confirming no state drift. Because update_by_squad_number_async always returns False (bug in source), the route raises 500; tests must assert the exact status code returned by the real SUT so they kill mutations that change the return value or the conditional check.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_same_status
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database (seeded row: Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid, complete payload matching squad_number=10
Record HTTP status code of first response
Send identical PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with the same payload
Record HTTP status code of second response
expected: Both responses return the same HTTP status code
Terminal state is identical after both calls (GET returns same data)
trace: R-PLAYER-029: repeated PUT with identical payload must produce same terminal state
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

payload = {
    "firstName": "Kabir",
    "middleName": "Mary",
    "lastName": "Reddy",
    "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "DM",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": False
}

def test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_same_status():
    r1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    r2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code
    assert r1.status_code in (204, 500)

test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_same_status()

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_decision_table_get_after_two_puts_same_resource_state
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=20 exists in the database (Reyansh Shah)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/20 with valid payload
Send identical PUT /players/squadnumber/20 with same payload
Send GET /players/squadnumber/20 to read terminal state
Assert GET response fields match the payload values exactly
expected: GET after two identical PUTs returns the original seeded data (since update_by_squad_number_async always returns False and rolls back, state is unchanged)
squadNumber in GET response equals 20 exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-029: terminal state after N identical PUTs equals terminal state after 1 PUT
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

payload_20 = {
    "firstName": "Reyansh",
    "middleName": None,
    "lastName": "Shah",
    "dateOfBirth": "1920-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 20,
    "position": "Central Midfield",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "Inter Milan",
    "league": "Serie A",
    "starting11": False
}

def test_put_idempotent_decision_table_get_after_two_puts_same_resource_state():
    r1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/20", json=payload_20)
    r2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/20", json=payload_20)
    assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/20")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 20
    assert body["firstName"] == "Reyansh"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Shah"

test_put_idempotent_decision_table_get_after_two_puts_same_resource_state()
